mission: Orient three thousand-year-old survivors to the modern galaxy, establish functional group dynamics, and chart a course toward Veranthos.
why_now: The survivors have just learned a thousand years have passed. Orientation cannot wait — they need context to function, and the group needs to move before Veraine gains more ground.
conflict: Ben vs. three experienced Force-users who don't recognize his authority or era
turning_point: Torin's quiet question about the modern Jedi's relationship with the light/dark boundary — 'Gavran thought so too. Before.' — seeds the arc that will break the group.
emotional_trajectory: The cycle of failure visible through survivors' eyes
notes: Group oriented, ship loaded, departure. Dynamics rocky but functional. Torin's quiet question about the light/dark boundary seeds his arc.
